_readme: INSTALLATION / LABOR, separate from the window or door price. types[].price is the install price per window. surcharges[] are per-window add-ons (amount × line quantity) and are not part of the labor price. Promo codes do not discount them. stuccoRepair is the optional estimate-level line (price × its own quantity). doors.panels is automatic patio-door labor by panel count, plus tallAdd when the door is taller than tallOverInches. doors.addons are per door. door-header is amount dollars per linear foot (headerFeet on the line). A write-in description and price on the door line is added with those add-ons. All of it rolls into the one Installation total. jobExtras are flat job-level lines. Frame types in data/frame-types.json point here: zbar -> standard, nailfin -> stucco-fin, block -> block.
